name: Exiled Sector Skill Tree
desc: This ship's Exiled Sector skill tree. Every bonus from its allocated nodes is aggregated and listed below. Click this hullmod to open the skill tree.

name: Exiled Sector Conflict Warning
desc: A hullmod on this ship was removed because it conflicts with an allocated skill tree node. Remove this hullmod to dismiss the notice.

name: Exiled Sector OP Reserve 1000
desc: Internal marker hullmod used by Exiled Sector to reserve 1000 ordnance points spent on allocated skill tree nodes. A ship carries up to four of these, adding up to the OP its paid nodes cost. Always installed automatically; not player-visible.
